migration_note: Clients may regenerate OpenAPI and optionally adopt the perimenopause analyzer endpoint.
summary: Additive perimenopause STRAW+10 analyzer contracts and evaluation endpoint (Harlow et al. 2012). Stages bleeding-pattern variability and amenorrhea windows to -3b through +2; flags hormonal contraception, pregnancy, postpartum, lactation as suppressors and post-hysterectomy as inapplicable per STRAW+10 applicability limits.

summary: Additive PCOS feature-pattern analyzer contracts and evaluation endpoint, aligned to the 2023 International Evidence-based Guideline (Teede et al.). Self-report features map to Rotterdam ovulatory-dysfunction and clinical-hyperandrogenism criteria; polycystic ovary morphology and biochemical androgens remain clinician-owned and out of scope for this analyzer.
